reviews.title: Very Clean, well thought out and good looking case...it's HUGE btw!
reviews.comment: Corsair put together REALLY nice cases...this one is no exception. It's HUGE btw, and heavy. Wire management is super nice, you get swing out doors as well as an interior metal door to keep all your wires behind. It has many usb front panel ports which are always handy to have. The case is also modular so if you wanted to vertically mount stuff, you could...expose or shroud the power supply, up to you...There are many spots for hard drives of all sizes from large 3.5's down to SSD's. One nice feature is the ease of removing the glass at the fans - they're held securely in place with friction fittings...and the fan mesh is a vinyl that is magnetically held in place so you can pull it out completely and get any dust off with ease. Overall, I'm super happy with the case, how it looks and it's function. It's well thought out and I'd defiantly suggest it to anyone looking to do a new build - this one is future proof in my opinion. Here are some pics of my build using the case...my rooms lighting is set for a gaming environment but the case is white...

reviews.title: Huge case!
reviews.comment: Arrived next day shipping. Shipping box was a little worn but upon opening product it was in perfect condition. Many different fan options to choose from and plenty of room for everything. Easy to work inside of case during parts installation. Only minor drawback was moving the front 3 140mm fans to the top. Fan cables were routed through the partition to divert air over mobo. Had to cut a zip tie that was difficult to reach to remove fans and then secure cables again. Bigger and more detailed instructions would be helpful to a beginner on how to disassemble the parts in the case. Would like to have had covers for some of the larger openings on the cable side of the case with rubber grommets like the other cable routing holes. Corsair needs to put out a very easy and descriptive chart regarding Commander daisy chains for multiple fans. 15 fans installed and was a bit of a guessing game on how to set up for power/rgb. Overall very happy with aesthetics, quality of build, ease of access and large door panel removal/installation. Case keeps temps about 5-7c cooler than previous Lian Li 216 mid tower. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark Orozco

reviews.title: Amazing case, and is absolutely massive, premium price, premium product.
reviews.comment: I gotta say this case is massive compared to my old 4000D airflow(comparison in attatched photos), but I need it to cool my parts and didn't wanna have to upgrade the case ever again. Despite how many features it has its actually pretty easy to build in and has 4 140mm fans, plus 2 fan hubs with 6 headers each for fans using the included commander core and a small pre installed fan hub. Case is massive and the thing easily fits my noctua NH-15 cooler and 3080 gpu. I would however say that the major complaint I have is the class pannels, because they restrict airflow ALOT, so I just took them off later on and Temps reduced. Cable management is pretty good, I'm just bad at it, but it is kinda tricky to route the pc fans from the front to the hub if you have fans in the side optional compartment spot, but it's possible. Overall really happy with this case and can't wait to see what else I can do with it.
reviews.author: Sage Sifford

reviews.title: Lots of room.
reviews.comment: This is a full tower. I was not expecting the case to be this big, but it is nice. This is my first time building a pc with a full tower. Lot is room for cables and other equipment like Corsair commander XT for RGB. Lots of capability. After my build was done, it weighed 64.6 pounds. If using a EATX motherboard, you will have to remove a panel in the back so it will fit. Fits all the GPU sizes. I have a 4080 in mine. It can fit a pretty big PSU, my PSU is a MSI Meg 1300p. I have 10 total fans mounted to my case and 6 of them are 140mm and 4 120mm. I am using a Corsair h115i 280mm water cooled CPU cooler. There are a lot of cable options and you can put many items in this case, which can make it difficult to close back cover. Take your time with cable management and you’ll figure it out. Overall I would buy this case again. It is heavy, and I love that.
reviews.author: Cannonlily

reviews.title: Very Good Case with Adjustments
reviews.comment: I gave this a 4 only because you can't give half stars or it would be a 3 1/2 stars. Why a 4? It's still a good case with options. Start with the bad and it's probably the only bad I have but it's huge; air flow vs aesthetics. The case has a lot options fans. It comes with 4, 3 in the front to bring air flow in and one in the rear to exhaust air. If you go more fans to bring in lights using corsair fans, which I did, you can create a serious air flow issue. The back side of the case allows for 3-4 case fans and if you are looking for aesthetics you would face the fans in to see all the colors vs the structural side of the fans but that makes them exhaust fans. If you place fans in the top, which I did for water colling, they also become exhaust fans. This means only 3 fans are bringing cool air in, which is not nearly enough for proper cooling. I've had a lot of over heating issues with both my CPU (water cooled - Not too bad) and my video card (air cooled - really bad to shutting down video). I have 10 corsair fans in the case; initially: 3 bringing air in and 7 exhaust. Not a good combo. So, if you go with a lot of fans for aesthetics and the set at the back of the case (no rear) must be pulling air in to help air flow. May not look as good but stops over heating. The good, everything else. Pretty large as I had zero issues placing a RTX 4090 is the case. Multiple options for hard drives if you are using 2.5 SSDs and more room than necessary for PSU and cabling, which can be tucked out of the way underneath the cover. There is enough room in the back for cable management but could be better. The front and top glass comes off to get at the screens for cleaning and to blow off fans when necessary. There's actually enough room in the cable management area for multiple corsair devices to control fans and lights. I have 2 commander core XTs and a lighting node pro. With the size, modular design, and extras that come with this case, this is the case for my next build.
